title: The god who came as a guest

plan.english: Grandmother, tell me a story about a guest! An old man came to the house of a widow. The widow gave him milk and her own seat. Who was the old man? He was a god, and he filled it with grain. Do gods come to our village? Who knows? We honour guests.
